title: Camera Count Tool manufacturer registry file
description: One file per manufacturer. Every method that can produce a displayed number must carry a citation. A model with no trusted method reports its count as unavailable.

manufacturer.description: Canonical manufacturer name as this project spells it.

manufacturer_aliases.description: Other spellings a camera may report, e.g. 'NIKON CORPORATION'.

usb_vendor_ids.description: Every USB vendor id this manufacturer ships cameras under. Each one carries its own citation.

reference.description: An http(s) URL, or a 'repo/path:line' reference into a public source tree.

identifier.description: Property code, operation code (hex), or MakerNotes group:tag name.

count_type.description: Manufacturer-defined counter kind. Counters are never merged or summed.

firmware_range.description: Firmware versions this method is documented for, e.g. '>=1.30'.

verification_status.description: Only documented and hardware_verified may produce a displayed number. hardware_verified additionally requires a row in docs/hardware-test-matrix.md.

value.description: Where the integer sits in the operation's answer. Required for ptp_operation methods; the shape must come from the same source as the citation, never from trial and error.

source.description: response_parameter: a 32-bit response parameter. data_uint32: a 32-bit little-endian integer in the data phase.

offset.description: Byte offset into the data phase, for source=data_uint32.

invalid_values.description: Values the manufacturer or the cited source documents as 'not available' rather than as a count. Reading one of these reports the counter as unavailable.

model.description: Model string exactly as the camera reports it, or "*" for a method documented in a manufacturer's main MakerNotes table rather than per model. A wildcard entry is used only when no exact model entry matches, and still reports unavailable when the field is absent from the file.

exact_count_available.description: True only when at least one method is documented or hardware_verified.
